description: Pin every version surface in a repository to commit hashes, integrity digests, or specific versions. SHA-pins GitHub Actions, integrity-pins Yarn and pnpm via Corepack, exact-pins package-manager dependencies (when application context is detected), migrates scaffolded CI to language version files, and pins install commands (go install, cargo install, pip, uv, npx). Optionally generates a weekly drift-audit script and tightens Dependabot.
name: pin-everything
